title: Session 4 (Nov 17): draft 2, the slides, and the red team on both - 21 changes plus the title count
summary:
Draft 2 applies only your Nov 12 answers: Carla Brennan leads; Act II is "Did a bot write this?" under a tough earnings call post; Onboard, Don't Program and The Chat Is Not Your Memory run live; Right Tool, Right Job, Automate the Invisible and Ghost in the Workflow are a talk track over slide 4 with Carla's prepared line; The AI Operations Manager is Part D; Own the Thinking and The Night Shift are out; Act IV numbers generic; reveal "This is a routine I run"; Taco Ep 4 "Seven ingredients, one taco."

**Slides (new, 8 slides, matching the Session 2 look):** https://claude.ai/artifact/JdWfArYazEDefYfAxJVEpn
**Red team (approved cast: Joan Mercer adversarial, Tom Brandt, Lena Fox, Kim Duong), two rounds, script and slides together:** https://github.com/level5consulting/ai-success-patterns/blob/overnight-2026-11-12/sessions/session-04/red-team-webinar-04.md

questions.text: Change 1: Say out loud how much of each comment is Carla's own - one line replaced on slide 4 suggests one human sentence is enough (Joan Mercer, adversarial)
Change 2: The softened reveal ("a routine I run") sounds like a hedge - reconsider the wording (Joan Mercer)
Change 3: Make Act II's bot comment almost right instead of an obvious gag, since that's the one people actually post (Joan Mercer)
Change 4: With Own the Thinking dropped, the string has no step where the person's own thinking is the point - add a line that covers it (Joan Mercer)
Change 5: Add a "skip these posts" rule (grief, layoffs, health) to the briefing and say it in the session (Joan Mercer)
Change 6: Drop "nothing ever posts for you" as a selling point on the page copy - it's the floor, not the feature (Joan Mercer)
Change 7: Put Act II's post where Carla's buyers are - an operations VP or plant manager after a tough quarter, not a CFO (Tom Brandt, buyer)
Change 8: Act V: make "a reply" the win and the meeting a bonus, not the two-week result (Tom Brandt)
Change 9: Slide 6: drop "profile visits" from the conversations measure (Tom Brandt)
Change 10: Put the briefing line "one specific thing from the post and one from my experience" on a slide (Tom Brandt)
Change 11: Pick Part D as live or slide before recording; if live, drop slide 5 from the deck (Lena Fox, producer)
Change 12: Slide 3: show the "solid = live, dashed = talk track" key on the slide and raise the dashed beads' contrast (Lena Fox)
Change 13: Slide 4: too much text at phone size - split it or cut the card text (Lena Fox)
Change 14: Slide 4 and Part C: say on screen that the struck line is the AI's draft (Lena Fox)
Change 15: Title says Seven, slide 3 shows six - settle the count before recording and fix title, notes and Taco Episode 4 together (Lena Fox)
Change 16: Write your exact save line for Part B in case the fresh chat misses the link rule (Lena Fox)
Change 17: Add the session page link on the last slide (Lena Fox)
Change 18: Say "here's the list" before the string slide so viewers know a list is coming (Kim Duong, first-timer)
Change 19: Explain "fit check" and "Past 24 hours filter" in plain words, or drop them from the slide (Kim Duong)
Change 20: Add a one-line printable list of the patterns to the session page for the closing ask (Kim Duong)
Change 21: Slide 6: replace "[ ___ ]" with a label like "Your number" (Kim Duong)
